dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Come with me, Metta! C'mon, they've got two-headed birds, three-eyed dragons, and treasure chests full of Mora that also bite!

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: And if you're lucky, you'll even see some fae! The wind blows like, "whooshoo, whooshooo!" And once that thick fog comes rolling in...

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Hehe! I can't wait to set off! Vesa and Metta — the best adventuring duo in all of Nod-Krai! Am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: I mean, yeah, sure... It's just that I remembered there's something I need to do. Maybe next time.

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Eh? But Metta, you just told someone else, "Father's not in today, which means I can go out on an adventure!" Didn't you...?

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: Well, yes, my friends from the Conch G... *cough* You must have misheard. I was just saying that I can't go out on an adventure. Father's not in today, so I need to take care of things at home.

dialogues.speaker: Metta
dialogues.text: But next time, alright? We'll go together next time we get a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Vesa
dialogues.text: Yeah! Woohoo! Alright, I'm getting up early every day, then! No way I'm missing out on the chance to go on an adventure with you!
